why: Already the right project root and avoids duplicate project authority.
Hierarchy and authority structures already exist in governance; propagation is the issue, not absence.
Roster ownership is already explicit and useful.
Reusable definition owner is already correct.
Planning, scheduling, forecast, and lookahead already share one coherent spine.
Field capture and labor reconciliation are already valuable; only fact-family boundaries need clarification.
Dual-lane constraint architecture exists and should be formalized, not replaced.
Demand, roster, and deployment all exist, but semantics are split across lanes.
Registry core is strong; provider-local seams should stay subordinate.
ODS, Project Health, KPI rollups, and legacy intelligence overlap and should become one hierarchy.
AI is already useful as a bounded downstream assistant and should remain so.
Budget Hierarchy and Earned Value are still missing, but current cost-code, PO, P&L, and production work should be preserved underneath.
